title: Once: Cache CLI Commands
summary: A Go-based CLI tool that caches command execution results using content-addressable storage, only re-executing commands when the command itself or its dependency files have changed.
problem_solved: Eliminates redundant CLI command executions by caching outputs and invalidating based on command and file dependency hashes
why_valuable: Improves developer productivity by skipping re-execution of expensive computations when inputs remain unchanged, similar to build systems but for arbitrary CLI commands
